memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “For the word of God is living and active, sharper than any two-edged sword…” – Hebrews 4:12

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
God’s Word is not a book of ideas; it is a living Sword in the believer’s hand. A sword is not meant for decoration but for warfare. The Word cuts deep it divides thoughts, motives, and hidden intentions.
It reveals the poison Satan planted and the purity God desires. This Sword is holy; to handle it lightly is dangerous. In the beginning was the Word and this Word is God Himself. When we read the Bible, we are encountering God in His purest voice.
Jesus defeated Satan in the wilderness not with emotions but with Scripture. Satan also used Scripture, but without truth, without light, without reverence.
Today many twist Scripture to deceive, distract, and destroy the faithful. A wrongly handled sword wounds the soldier who carries it.  So a believer must be trained, disciplined, and rooted in Scripture. Truth handled without fear of God becomes pride. Truth handled with humility becomes power. The Sword of the Spirit protects us from corruption and confusion. It exposes false teachings that sound sweet but kill slowly. In the coming days, deception will increase but the Word will defend us. Stay alert, sharpened, and soaked in Scripture every day. The sword in your hand must also become the sword in your heart. With this Sword, let us fight and finish victorious.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “Sin will keep you from the Bible, or the Bible will keep you from sin.” – D. L. Moody

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, train my heart to handle Your Word with holiness. Give me discernment to overcome deception and strength to stand firmk in truth. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the Sword of the Spirit strengthen your faith.
May truth guide your steps in every battle.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: Knowing Scripture
recommended_book.author: R. C. Sproul
recommended_book.quote: “God… has provided His own Holy Spirit to illumine His Word and search out its application to our lives.” – The Word is powerful because the Spirit actively uses it to transform us
